_comment: Parameter schema for the Retell custom function `create_order`. With 'Payload: args only' enabled on the function, Retell POSTs exactly this object (no {name, call, args} wrapper) to the URL below, which is the shape POST /api/orders expects. Paste the `parameters` object into the function's JSON editor; set the other fields from the table in README.md.
name: create_order
description: Save the caller's confirmed pizza order. Call this exactly once, only after the caller has explicitly said yes to the full order read-back. Returns { confirmation_number }.

customer_name.description: The caller's full name for the order.

phone.description: The caller's callback phone number, digits only, no spaces or dashes.

fulfillment_type.description: Whether the caller is collecting the order or wants it delivered.

address.description: Full delivery street address. Include ONLY when fulfillment_type is 'delivery'; omit entirely for pickup.

items.description: One entry per distinct pizza on the order.

name.description: Menu pizza name (Margherita, Pepperoni, or Veggie Supreme). Append any extra toppings in parentheses, e.g. 'Pepperoni (extra cheese, mushrooms)'.

qty.description: How many of this exact pizza (same size, same toppings).

price.description: Per-unit price in dollars for ONE of this pizza at this size, including its extra toppings (size price + 1.50 per extra topping).

total.description: Order total in dollars: the sum of price * qty across every item. No tax, no delivery fee.
